digest.component_or_area: CI workflow configuration and pytest timeout configuration
propositions: CLI pytest --timeout flags on _build-and-test.yml shared-tier lanes permanently shadow ini-based timeout budget changes because trusted-main workflow files take precedence over patchset changes
Patchset modifications to timeout configuration in pyproject.toml cannot be exercised by the patchset's own Verified CI run while CLI flags exist in the workflow

Removal of --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread CLI flags from both shared-tier lanes and delegation to pyproject.toml ini configuration aligns with ecosystem-standard practice (scikit-learn, pandas, numpy)
The conftest-floor mechanism approach (branch preserve/timeout-floor-hardening) is rejected because pytest-timeout resolves config._env_timeout at session start read-only with no supported hook point
